_template_meta.description: Checks GitHub Trending each morning and emails you once per newly-trending repository above a configurable star threshold. Agent memory prevents duplicates across runs.

scenario.name: GitHub Trending Daily Brief
scenario.description: Checks GitHub Trending each morning and emails you once per newly-trending repository above a configurable star threshold. Agent memory prevents duplicates across runs.

agents.name: Fetch GitHub Trending
agents.description: Scrapes https://github.com/trending each morning. Leave language blank for all languages, or set it to a slug like 'python', 'typescript', or 'rust'. Runs daily at 08:00.

agents.name: Filter High-Momentum Repos
agents.description: Keeps only repositories that gained 50 or more stars today. Raise the threshold (e.g. 200) for only breakout repos, or lower it for broader coverage.

agents.name: Format Notification
agents.description: Builds a subject line and plain-text email body from the repository metadata.

templates.subject: Trending on GitHub: {{ name }}{% if language %} ({{ language }}){% endif %} — {{ stars_today }} stars today

agents.name: Send Email
agents.description: Sends one email per qualifying repository. Change to_email to your address before enabling.
